editorial:
Elizabeth Halsey is the kind of teacher who shows movies in class, sleeps at her desk, and barely tries. When her rich fiancé dumps her, she is forced back into the classroom with one goal: save enough money for a boob job. That setup alone tells you this is not your feel-good teacher movie. Cameron Diaz plays Elizabeth with zero apologies, leaning hard into her selfish, lazy, and sometimes mean behavior. You are not meant to root for her at first, which makes the whole thing feel fresh and a little dangerous. The supporting cast, including Jason Segel as the gym teacher who sees through her and Lucy Punch as the overachieving rival, keeps the energy high.

Standout moments come from sharp back-and-forth between Elizabeth and her coworkers, plus funny set pieces pushing the R-rated humor. The pacing is quick and jokes land often, though some gags repeat and the story never really asks Elizabeth to grow. If you like dark, mean-spirited comedy without a hero to cheer for, this is a fun pick. Watch it streaming in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Elizabeth cheats her way to the top state test scores, winning the big bonus she needs for her surgery. She gets the boob job and finally seems a little happier, but instead of landing the rich substitute teacher, she ends up with the gym teacher Russell, who liked her all along. The overachieving rival Amy gets exposed and pushed out, and Elizabeth keeps her job with a slightly better attitude.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark comedy and doesn't mind an unlikable lead.
